verses.en: Then said the high priest, Are these things so?
verses.pt: E disse o sumo sacerdote: Porventura são assim estas coisas?
verses.en_web: The high priest said, “Are these things so?”
verses.en_bbe: Then the high priest said, Are these things true?

verses.en: And he said, Men, brethren, and fathers, hearken; The God of glory appeared unto our father Abraham, when he was in Mesopotamia, before he dwelt in Charran,
verses.pt: Estêvão respondeu: Irmãos e pais, ouvi. O Deus da glória apareceu a nosso pai Abraão, estando ele na Mesopotâmia, antes de habitar em Harã,
verses.en_web: He said, “Brothers and fathers, listen. The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham, when he was in Mesopotamia, before he lived in Haran,
verses.en_bbe: And he said, My brothers and fathers, give hearing. The God of glory came to our father Abraham, when he was in Mesopotamia, before he was living in Haran,

verses.en: And said unto him, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and come into the land which I shall shew thee.
verses.pt: e disse-lhe: Sai da tua terra e dentre a tua parentela, e dirige-te à terra que eu te mostrar.
verses.en_web: and said to him, ‘Get out of your land, and from your relatives, and come into a land which I will show you.’
verses.en_bbe: And said to him, Go out of your land, and away from your family, and come into the land to which I will be your guide.

verses.en: Then came he out of the land of the Chaldaeans, and dwelt in Charran: and from thence, when his father was dead, he removed him into this land, wherein ye now dwell.
verses.pt: Então saiu da terra dos caldeus e habitou em Harã. Dali, depois que seu pai faleceu, Deus o trouxe para esta terra em que vós agora habitais.
verses.en_web: Then he came out of the land of the Chaldaeans, and lived in Haran. From there, when his father was dead, God moved him into this land, where you are now living.
verses.en_bbe: Then he came out of the land of the Chaldaeans, and went into Haran; and from there, when his father was dead, he was guided by God into this land, where you are living now:

verses.en: And he gave him none inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on: yet he promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his seed after him, when as yet he had no child.
verses.pt: E não lhe deu nela herança, nem sequer o espaço de um pé; mas prometeu que lha daria em possessão, e depois dele à sua descendência, não tendo ele ainda filho.
verses.en_web: He gave him no inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on. He promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his offspring after him, when he still had no child.
verses.en_bbe: And God gave him no heritage in it, not even enough to put his foot on: but he gave him an undertaking that he would give it to him and to his children after him, though he had no child at that time.

verses.en: And God spake on this wise, That his seed should sojourn in a strange land; and that they should bring them into bondage, and entreat them evil four hundred years.
verses.pt: Pois Deus disse que a sua descendência seria peregrina em terra estranha e que a escravizariam e maltratariam por quatrocentos anos.
verses.en_web: God spoke in this way: that his offspring would live as aliens in a strange land, and that they would be enslaved and mistreated for four hundred years.
verses.en_bbe: And God said that his seed would be living in a strange land, and that they would make them servants, and be cruel to them for four hundred years.

verses.en: And the nation to whom they shall be in bondage will I judge, said God: and after that shall they come forth, and serve me in this place.
verses.pt: Mas eu julgarei a nação que os tiver escravizado, disse Deus; e depois disto sairão, e me servirão neste lugar.
verses.en_web: ‘I will judge the nation to which they will be in bondage,’ said God, ‘and after that will they come out, and serve me in this place.’
verses.en_bbe: And I will be the judge, said God, of that nation which made them servants: and after that, they will come out and give me worship in this place.

verses.en: And he gave him the covenant of circumcision: and so Abraham begat Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat the twelve patriarchs.
verses.pt: E deu-lhe o pacto da circuncisão; assim então gerou Abraão a Isaque, e o circuncidou ao oitavo dia; e Isaque gerou a Jacó, e Jacó aos doze patriarcas.
verses.en_web: He gave him the covenant of circumcision. So Abraham became the father of Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day. Isaac became the father of Jacob, and Jacob became the father of the twelve patriarchs.
verses.en_bbe: And he made with him the agreement of which circumcision was the sign. And so Abraham had a son, Isaac, and gave him circumcision on the eighth day; and Isaac had a son, Jacob, and Jacob was the father of the twelve heads of the families of Israel.

verses.en: And the patriarchs, moved with envy, sold Joseph into Egypt: but God was with him,
verses.pt: Os patriarcas, movidos de inveja, venderam José para o Egito; mas Deus era com ele,
verses.en_web: “The patriarchs, moved with jealousy against Joseph, sold him into Egypt. God was with him,
verses.en_bbe: And the brothers, moved with envy against Joseph, gave him to the Egyptians for money: but God was with him,

verses.en: And delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favour and wisdom in the sight of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and he made him governor over Egypt and all his house.
verses.pt: e o livrou de todas as suas tribulações, e lhe deu graça e sabedoria perante Faraó, rei do Egito, que o constituiu governador sobre o Egito e toda a sua casa.
verses.en_web: and delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favor and wisdom before Pharaoh, king of Egypt. He made him governor over Egypt and all his house.
verses.en_bbe: And made him free from all his troubles, and gave him wisdom and the approval of Pharaoh, king of Egypt, who made him ruler over Egypt and all his house.

verses.en: Now there came a dearth over all the land of Egypt and Chanaan, and great affliction: and our fathers found no sustenance.
verses.pt: Sobreveio então uma fome a todo o Egito e Canaã, e grande tribulação; e nossos pais não achavam alimentos.
verses.en_web: Now a famine came over all the land of Egypt and Canaan, and great affliction. Our fathers found no food.
verses.en_bbe: Now there was no food to be had in all Egypt and Canaan, and there was great trouble: and our fathers were not able to get food.

verses.en: But when Jacob heard that there was corn in Egypt, he sent out our fathers first.
verses.pt: Mas tendo ouvido Jacó que no Egito havia trigo, enviou ali nossos pais pela primeira vez.
verses.en_web: But when Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent out our fathers the first time.
verses.en_bbe: But Jacob, hearing that there was grain in Egypt, sent out our fathers the first time.

verses.en: And at the second time Joseph was made known to his brethren; and Joseph’s kindred was made known unto Pharaoh.
verses.pt: E na segunda vez deu-se José a conhecer a seus irmãos, e a sua linhagem tornou-se manifesta a Faraó.
verses.en_web: On the second time Joseph was made known to his brothers, and Joseph’s race was revealed to Pharaoh.
verses.en_bbe: And the second time his brothers had a meeting with Joseph, and Pharaoh had knowledge of Joseph's family.

verses.en: Then sent Joseph, and called his father Jacob to him, and all his kindred, threescore and fifteen souls.
verses.pt: Então José mandou chamar a seu pai Jacó, e a toda a sua parentela - setenta e cinco almas.
verses.en_web: Joseph sent, and summoned Jacob, his father, and all his relatives, seventy-five souls.
verses.en_bbe: Then Joseph sent for Jacob his father and all his family, seventy-five persons.

verses.en: So Jacob went down into Egypt, and died, he, and our fathers,
verses.pt: Jacó, pois, desceu ao Egito, onde morreu, ele e nossos pais;
verses.en_web: Jacob went down into Egypt, and he died, himself and our fathers,
verses.en_bbe: And Jacob went down to Egypt, and came to his end there, and so did our fathers;

verses.en: And were carried over into Sychem, and laid in the sepulchre that Abraham bought for a sum of money of the sons of Emmor the father of Sychem.
verses.pt: e foram transportados para Siquém e depositados na sepultura que Abraão comprara por certo preço em prata aos filhos de Emor, em Siquém.
verses.en_web: and they were brought back to Shechem, and laid in the tomb that Abraham bought for a price in silver from the children of Hamor of Shechem.
verses.en_bbe: And they were taken over to Shechem, and put to rest in the place which Abraham got for a price in silver from the sons of Hamor in Shechem.

verses.en: But when the time of the promise drew nigh, which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,
verses.pt: Enquanto se aproximava o tempo da promessa que Deus tinha feito a Abraão, o povo crescia e se multiplicava no Egito;
verses.en_web: “But as the time of the promise came close which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,
verses.en_bbe: But when the time was near for putting into effect the undertaking which God had given to Abraham, the people were increasing in Egypt,

verses.en: Till another king arose, which knew not Joseph.
verses.pt: até que se levantou ali outro rei, que não tinha conhecido José.
verses.en_web: until there arose a different king, who didn’t know Joseph.
verses.en_bbe: Till another king came to power, who had no knowledge of Joseph.

verses.en: The same dealt subtilly with our kindred, and evil entreated our fathers, so that they cast out their young children, to the end they might not live.
verses.pt: Usando esse de astúcia contra a nossa raça, maltratou a nossos pais, ao ponto de fazê-los enjeitar seus filhos, para que não vivessem.
verses.en_web: The same took advantage of our race, and mistreated our fathers, and forced them to throw out their babies, so that they wouldn’t stay alive.
verses.en_bbe: He, having evil designs against our nation, was cruel to our fathers, and they were forced to put out their young children, so that they might not go on living.

verses.en: In which time Moses was born, and was exceeding fair, and nourished up in his father’s house three months:
verses.pt: Nesse tempo nasceu Moisés, e era mui formoso, e foi criado três meses em casa de seu pai.
verses.en_web: At that time Moses was born, and was exceedingly handsome. He was nourished three months in his father’s house.
verses.en_bbe: At which time Moses came to birth, and he was very beautiful; and he was kept for three months in his father's house:

verses.en: And when he was cast out, Pharaoh’s daughter took him up, and nourished him for her own son.
verses.pt: Sendo ele enjeitado, a filha de Faraó o recolheu e o criou como seu próprio filho.
verses.en_web: When he was thrown out, Pharaoh’s daughter took him up, and reared him as her own son.
verses.en_bbe: And when he was put out, Pharaoh's daughter took him and kept him as her son.

verses.en: And Moses was learned in all the wisdom of the Egyptians, and was mighty in words and in deeds.
verses.pt: Assim Moisés foi instruído em toda a sabedoria dos egípcios, e era poderoso em palavras e obras.
verses.en_web: Moses was instructed in all the wisdom of the Egyptians. He was mighty in his words and works.
verses.en_bbe: And Moses was trained in all the wisdom of Egypt, and was great in his words and works.

verses.en: And when he was full forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brethren the children of Israel.
verses.pt: Ora, quando ele completou quarenta anos, veio-lhe ao coração visitar seus irmãos, os filhos de Israel.
verses.en_web: But when he was forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brothers, the children of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: But when he was almost forty years old, it came into his heart to go and see his brothers, the children of Israel.

verses.en: And seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him, and avenged him that was oppressed, and smote the Egyptian:
verses.pt: E vendo um deles sofrer injustamente, defendeu-o, e vingou o oprimido, matando o egípcio.
verses.en_web: Seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him, and avenged him who was oppressed, striking the Egyptian.
verses.en_bbe: And seeing one of them being attacked, he went to his help and gave the Egyptian a death-blow:

verses.en: For he supposed his brethren would have understood how that God by his hand would deliver them: but they understood not.
verses.pt: Cuidava que seus irmãos entenderiam que por mão dele Deus lhes havia de dar a liberdade; mas eles não entenderam.
verses.en_web: He supposed that his brothers understood that God, by his hand, was giving them deliverance; but they didn’t understand.
verses.en_bbe: And he was hoping that his brothers would see that God had sent him to be their saviour; but they did not see.

verses.en: And the next day he shewed himself unto them as they strove, and would have set them at one again, saying, Sirs, ye are brethren; why do ye wrong one to another?
verses.pt: No dia seguinte apareceu-lhes quando brigavam, e quis levá- los à paz, dizendo: Homens, sois irmãos; por que vos maltratais um ao outro?
verses.en_web: “The day following, he appeared to them as they fought, and urged them to be at peace again, saying, ‘Sirs, you are brothers. Why do you wrong one another?’
verses.en_bbe: And the day after, he came to them, while they were having a fight, and would have made peace between them, saying, Sirs, you are brothers; why do you do wrong to one another?

verses.en: But he that did his neighbour wrong thrust him away, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge over us?
verses.pt: Mas o que fazia injustiça ao seu próximo o repeliu, dizendo: Quem te constituiu senhor e juiz sobre nós?
verses.en_web: But he who did his neighbor wrong pushed him away, saying, ‘Who made you a ruler and a judge over us?
verses.en_bbe: But the man who was doing wrong to his neighbour, pushing him away, said, Who made you a ruler and a judge over us?

verses.en: Wilt thou kill me, as thou diddest the Egyptian yesterday?
verses.pt: Acaso queres tu matar-me como ontem mataste o egípcio?
verses.en_web: Do you want to kill me, as you killed the Egyptian yesterday?’
verses.en_bbe: Will you put me to death as you did the Egyptian yesterday?

verses.en: Then fled Moses at this saying, and was a stranger in the land of Madian, where he begat two sons.
verses.pt: A esta palavra fugiu Moisés, e tornou-se peregrino na terra de Madiã, onde gerou dois filhos.
verses.en_web: Moses fled at this saying, and became a stranger in the land of Midian, where he became the father of two sons.
verses.en_bbe: And at these words, Moses went in flight to the land of Midian, and was living there for a time, and had two sons.

verses.en: And when forty years were expired, there appeared to him in the wilderness of mount Sina an angel of the Lord in a flame of fire in a bush.
verses.pt: E passados mais quarenta anos, apareceu-lhe um anjo no deserto do monte Sinai, numa chama de fogo no meio de uma sarça.
verses.en_web: “When forty years were fulfilled, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in the wilderness of Mount Sinai, in a flame of fire in a bush.
verses.en_bbe: At the end of forty years, an angel came to him in the waste land of Sinai, in the flame of a burning thorn-tree.

verses.en: When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight: and as he drew near to behold it, the voice of the Lord came unto him,
verses.pt: Moisés, vendo isto, admirou-se da visão; e, aproximando-se ele para observar, soou a voz do Senhor;
verses.en_web: When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight. As he came close to see, a voice of the Lord came to him,
verses.en_bbe: And Moses, seeing it, was full of wonder, and when he came up to have a nearer view of it, the voice of the Lord came to him, saying,

verses.en: Saying, I am the God of thy fathers, the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. Then Moses trembled, and durst not behold.
verses.pt: Eu sou o deus de teus pais, o Deus de Abraão, de Isaque e de Jacó. E Moisés ficou trêmulo e não ousava olhar.
verses.en_web: ‘I am the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’ Moses trembled, and dared not look.
verses.en_bbe: I am the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham and of Isaac and of Jacob. And Moses, shaking with fear, kept his eyes from looking at it.

verses.en: Then said the Lord to him, Put off thy shoes from thy feet: for the place where thou standest is holy ground.
verses.pt: Disse-lhe então o Senhor: Tira as alparcas dos teus pés, porque o lugar em que estás é terra santa.
verses.en_web: The Lord said to him, ‘Take off your sandals, for the place where you stand is holy ground.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said, Take off the shoes from your feet, for the place where you are is holy.

verses.en: I have seen, I have seen the affliction of my people which is in Egypt, and I have heard their groaning, and am come down to deliver them. And now come, I will send thee into Egypt.
verses.pt: Vi, com efeito, a aflição do meu povo no Egito, ouvi os seus gemidos, e desci para livrá-lo. Agora pois vem, e enviar-te-ei ao Egito.
verses.en_web: I have surely seen the affliction of my people that is in Egypt, and have heard their groaning. I have come down to deliver them. Now come, I will send you into Egypt.’
verses.en_bbe: Truly, I have seen the sorrows of my people in Egypt, and their cries have come to my ears, and I have come down to make them free: and now, come, I will send you to Egypt.

verses.en: This Moses whom they refused, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge? the same did God send to be a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel which appeared to him in the bush.
verses.pt: A este Moisés que eles haviam repelido, dizendo: Quem te constituiu senhor e juiz? a este enviou Deus como senhor e libertador, pela mão do anjo que lhe aparecera na sarça.
verses.en_web: “This Moses, whom they refused, saying, ‘Who made you a ruler and a judge?’—God has sent him as both a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel who appeared to him in the bush.
verses.en_bbe: This Moses, whom they would not have, saying, Who made you a ruler and a judge? him God sent to be a ruler and a saviour, by the hand of the angel whom he saw in the thorn-tree.

verses.en: He brought them out, after that he had shewed wonders and signs in the land of Egypt, and in the Red sea, and in the wilderness forty years.
verses.pt: Foi este que os conduziu para fora, fazendo prodígios e sinais na terra do Egito, e no Mar Vermelho, e no deserto por quarenta anos.
verses.en_web: This man led them out, having worked wonders and signs in Egypt, in the Red Sea, and in the wilderness for forty years.
verses.en_bbe: This man took them out, having done wonders and signs in Egypt and in the Red Sea and in the waste land, for forty years.

verses.en: This is that Moses, which said unto the children of Israel, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear.
verses.pt: Este é o Moisés que disse aos filhos de Israel: Deus vos suscitará dentre vossos irmãos um profeta como eu.
verses.en_web: This is that Moses, who said to the children of Israel, ‘The Lord our God will raise up a prophet for you from among your brothers, like me.’
verses.en_bbe: This is the same Moses, who said to the children of Israel, God will give you a prophet from among your brothers, like me.

verses.en: This is he, that was in the church in the wilderness with the angel which spake to him in the mount Sina, and with our fathers: who received the lively oracles to give unto us:
verses.pt: Este é o que esteve na congregação no deserto, com o anjo que lhe falava no monte Sinai, e com nossos pais, o qual recebeu palavras de vida para vo-las dar;
verses.en_web: This is he who was in the assembly in the wilderness with the angel that spoke to him on Mount Sinai, and with our fathers, who received living revelations to give to us,
verses.en_bbe: This is the man who was in the church in the waste land with the angel who was talking to him in Sinai, and with our fathers; and to him were given the living words of God, so that he might give them to you.

verses.en: To whom our fathers would not obey, but thrust him from them, and in their hearts turned back again into Egypt,
verses.pt: ao qual os nossos pais não quiseram obedecer, antes o rejeitaram, e em seus corações voltaram ao Egito,
verses.en_web: to whom our fathers wouldn’t be obedient, but rejected him, and turned back in their hearts to Egypt,
verses.en_bbe: By whom our fathers would not be controlled; but they put him on one side, turning back in their hearts to Egypt,

verses.en: Saying unto Aaron, Make us gods to go before us: for as for this Moses, which brought us out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.
verses.pt: dizendo a arão: Faze-nos deuses que vão adiante de nós; porque a esse Moisés que nos tirou da terra do Egito, não sabemos o que lhe aconteceu.
verses.en_web: saying to Aaron, ‘Make us gods that will go before us, for as for this Moses, who led us out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.’
verses.en_bbe: And saying to Aaron, Make us gods to go before us: as for this Moses, who took us out of the land of Egypt, we have no idea what has become of him.

verses.en: And they made a calf in those days, and offered sacrifice unto the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their own hands.
verses.pt: Fizeram, pois, naqueles dias o bezerro, e ofereceram sacrifício ao ídolo, e se alegravam nas obras das suas mãos.
verses.en_web: They made a calf in those days, and brought a sacrifice to the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their hands.
verses.en_bbe: And they made the image of a young ox in those days, and made an offering to it, and had joy in the work of their hands.

verses.en: Then God turned, and gave them up to worship the host of heaven; as it is written in the book of the prophets, O ye house of Israel, have ye offered to me slain beasts and sacrifices by the space of forty years in the wilderness?
verses.pt: Mas Deus se afastou, e os abandonou ao culto das hostes do céu, como está escrito no livro dos profetas: Porventura me oferecestes vítimas e sacrifícios por quarenta anos no deserto, ó casa de Israel?
verses.en_web: But God turned, and gave them up to serve the army of the sky, as it is written in the book of the prophets, ‘Did you offer to me slain animals and sacrifices forty years in the wilderness, O house of Israel?
verses.en_bbe: But God was turned from them and let them give worship to the stars of heaven, as it says in the book of the prophets, Did you make offerings to me of sheep and oxen for forty years in the waste land, O house of Israel?

verses.en: Yea, ye took up the tabernacle of Moloch, and the star of your god Remphan, figures which ye made to worship them: and I will carry you away beyond Babylon.
verses.pt: Antes carregastes o tabernáculo de Moloque e a estrela do deus Renfã, figuras que vós fizestes para adorá-las. Desterrar-vos-ei pois, para além da Babilônia.
verses.en_web: You took up the tabernacle of Moloch, the star of your god Rephan, the figures which you made to worship. I will carry you away beyond Babylon.’
verses.en_bbe: And you took up the tent of Moloch and the star of the god Rephan, images which you made to give worship to them: and I will take you away, farther than Babylon.

verses.en: Our fathers had the tabernacle of witness in the wilderness, as he had appointed, speaking unto Moses, that he should make it according to the fashion that he had seen.
verses.pt: Entre os nossos pais no deserto estava o tabernáculo do testemunho, como ordenara aquele que disse a Moisés que o fizesse segundo o modelo que tinha visto;
verses.en_web: “Our fathers had the tabernacle of the testimony in the wilderness, even as he who spoke to Moses commanded him to make it according to the pattern that he had seen;
verses.en_bbe: Our fathers had the Tent of witness in the waste land, as God gave orders to Moses to make it after the design which he had seen.

verses.en: Which also our fathers that came after brought in with Jesus into the possession of the Gentiles, whom God drave out before the face of our fathers, unto the days of David;
verses.pt: o qual nossos pais, tendo-o por sua vez recebido, o levaram sob a direção de Josué, quando entraram na posse da terra das nações que Deus expulsou da presença dos nossos pais, até os dias de Davi,
verses.en_web: which also our fathers, in their turn, brought in with Joshua when they entered into the possession of the nations, whom God drove out before the face of our fathers, to the days of David,
verses.en_bbe: Which our fathers, in their turn, took with them when, with Joshua, they came into the heritage of the nations whom God was driving out before the face of our fathers, till the time of David,

verses.en: Who found favour before God, and desired to find a tabernacle for the God of Jacob.
verses.pt: que achou graça diante de Deus, e pediu que lhe fosse dado achar habitação para o Deus de Jacó.
verses.en_web: who found favor in the sight of God, and asked to find a habitation for the God of Jacob.
verses.en_bbe: Who was pleasing to God; and he had a desire to make a holy tent for the God of Jacob.

verses.en: But Solomon built him an house.
verses.pt: Entretanto foi Salomão quem lhe edificou uma casa;
verses.en_web: But Solomon built him a house.
verses.en_bbe: But Solomon was the builder of his house.

verses.en: Howbeit the most High dwelleth not in temples made with hands; as saith the prophet,
verses.pt: mas o Altíssimo não habita em templos feitos por mãos de homens, como diz o profeta:
verses.en_web: However, the Most High doesn’t dwell in temples made with hands, as the prophet says,
verses.en_bbe: But still, the Most High has not his resting-place in houses made with hands, as the prophet says,

verses.en: Heaven is my throne, and earth is my footstool: what house will ye build me? saith the Lord: or what is the place of my rest?
verses.pt: O céu é meu trono, e a terra o escabelo dos meus pés. Que casa me edificareis, diz o Senhor, ou qual o lugar do meu repouso?
verses.en_web: ‘heaven is my throne, and the earth a footstool for my feet. What kind of house will you build me?’ says the Lord. ‘Or what is the place of my rest?
verses.en_bbe: Heaven is the seat of my power, and earth is a resting-place for my feet: what sort of house will you make for me, says the Lord, or what is my place of rest?

verses.en: Hath not my hand made all these things?
verses.pt: Não fez, porventura, a minha mão todas estas coisas?
verses.en_web: Didn’t my hand make all these things?’
verses.en_bbe: Did not my hand make all these things?

verses.en: Ye stiffnecked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, ye do always resist the Holy Ghost: as your fathers did, so do ye.
verses.pt: Homens de dura cerviz, e incircuncisos de coração e ouvido, vós sempre resistis ao Espírito Santo; como o fizeram os vossos pais, assim também vós.
verses.en_web: “You stiff-necked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, you always resist the Holy Spirit! As your fathers did, so you do.
verses.en_bbe: You whose hearts are hard and whose ears are shut to me; you are ever working against the Holy Spirit; as your fathers did, so do you.

verses.en: Which of the prophets have not your fathers persecuted? and they have slain them which shewed before of the coming of the Just One; of whom ye have been now the betrayers and murderers:
verses.pt: A qual dos profetas não perseguiram vossos pais? Até mataram os que dantes anunciaram a vinda do Justo, do qual vós agora vos tornastes traidores e homicidas,
verses.en_web: Which of the prophets didn’t your fathers persecute? They killed those who foretold the coming of the Righteous One, of whom you have now become betrayers and murderers.
verses.en_bbe: Which of the prophets was not cruelly attacked by your fathers? and they put to death those who gave them the news of the coming of the Upright One; whom you have now given up and put to death;

verses.en: Who have received the law by the disposition of angels, and have not kept it.
verses.pt: vós, que recebestes a lei por ordenação dos anjos, e não a guardastes.
verses.en_web: You received the law as it was ordained by angels, and didn’t keep it!”
verses.en_bbe: You, to whom the law was given as it was ordered by angels, and who have not kept it.

verses.en: When they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed on him with their teeth.
verses.pt: Ouvindo eles isto, enfureciam-se em seus corações, e rangiam os dentes contra Estêvão.
verses.en_web: Now when they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed at him with their teeth.
verses.en_bbe: Hearing these things, they were cut to the heart and moved with wrath against him.

verses.en: But he, being full of the Holy Ghost, looked up stedfastly into heaven, and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,
verses.pt: Mas ele, cheio do Espírito Santo, fitando os olhos no céu, viu a glória de Deus, e Jesus em pé à direita de Deus,
verses.en_web: But he, being full of the Holy Spirit, looked up steadfastly into heaven, and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,
verses.en_bbe: But he was full of the Holy Spirit, and looking up to heaven, he saw the glory of God and Jesus at the right hand of God.

verses.en: And said, Behold, I see the heavens opened, and the Son of man standing on the right hand of God.
verses.pt: e disse: Eis que vejo os céus abertos, e o Filho do homem em pé à direita de Deus.
verses.en_web: and said, “Behold, I see the heavens opened, and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God!”
verses.en_bbe: And he said, Now I see heaven open, and the Son of man at the right hand of God.

verses.en: Then they cried out with a loud voice, and stopped their ears, and ran upon him with one accord,
verses.pt: Então eles gritaram com grande voz, taparam os ouvidos, e arremeteram unânimes contra ele
verses.en_web: But they cried out with a loud voice, and stopped their ears, and rushed at him with one accord.
verses.en_bbe: But with loud cries, and stopping their ears, they made an attack on him all together,

verses.en: And cast him out of the city, and stoned him: and the witnesses laid down their clothes at a young man’s feet, whose name was Saul.
verses.pt: e, lançando-o fora da cidade o apedrejavam. E as testemunhas depuseram as suas vestes aos pés de um mancebo chamado Saulo.
verses.en_web: They threw him out of the city, and stoned him. The witnesses placed their garments at the feet of a young man named Saul.
verses.en_bbe: Driving him out of the town and stoning him: and the witnesses put their clothing at the feet of a young man named Saul.

verses.en: And they stoned Stephen, calling upon God, and saying, Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.
verses.pt: Apedrejavam, pois, a Estêvão que orando, dizia: Senhor Jesus, recebe o meu espírito.
verses.en_web: They stoned Stephen as he called out, saying, “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit!”
verses.en_bbe: And Stephen, while he was being stoned, made prayer to God, saying, Lord Jesus, take my spirit.

verses.en: And he kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, Lord, lay not this sin to their charge. And when he had said this, he fell asleep.
verses.pt: E pondo-se de joelhos, clamou com grande voz: Senhor, não lhes imputes este pecado. Tendo dito isto, adormeceu. E Saulo consentia na sua morte.
verses.en_web: He kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, “Lord, don’t hold this sin against them!” When he had said this, he fell asleep.
verses.en_bbe: And going down on his knees, he said in a loud voice, Lord, do not make them responsible for this sin. And when he had said this, he went to his rest.
